query: Help me understand what's worth analyzing in these incident tickets.

per_column.name: resolution_time_hours
per_column.rationale: Resolution time is a highly useful axis for incident analysis (SLA, bottlenecks). But the values are not grounded: closed_at equals sys_updated_on in every sample, so the true resolution span isn't derivable from the shown fields, and produced values (286.8, 348.6, 418.8) are inconsistent with the identical timestamps. A negative value (-4.3) is impossible and confirms fabricated/erroneous computation.

per_column.name: is_critical
per_column.rationale: A criticality flag could support prioritization analysis, but it is largely redundant with the existing 'priority' column and is a bare binary flag, limiting new leverage. It is plausibly derivable from priority; the samples show all 0 which is consistent but not strongly verifiable from the shown text.

per_column.name: domain_type
per_column.rationale: Categorizing tickets into Infrastructure/Database/Software gives a genuine grouping axis for analysis and is somewhat distinct from the raw 'category'. Values are well-grounded readings of short_description (database->Database, VPN/intranet/internet->Infrastructure, software update->Software).

per_column.name: recurrence_indicator
per_column.rationale: Recurrence/repeat-issue detection is a reasonable analytical axis. But the integer values (0,1,2,3) are not clearly derivable from single-row text; 'frequent disconnection' got 1 while a plain 'software update issue' also got 0 and 'database' got 1, showing no coherent, text-supported mapping. The values appear asserted rather than grounded.

judge.rationale: The added columns offer genuinely useful new axes (domain categorization, resolution time, criticality, recurrence) beyond the raw fields, so analytical usefulness is moderate-to-high overall. However groundedness is dragged down by resolution_time_hours (impossible negatives and values inconsistent with identical closed_at/sys_updated_on timestamps) and recurrence_indicator (integer counts with no coherent basis in the single-row source text). domain_type is well-grounded and is_critical is plausible though redundant with priority.
